title: Unused range-loop variable `i` — Odin rejects this test file
detail: Odin errors on unused locals, including range-loop indices ('i' declared and not used); the loop body never references `i`. `odin test app/input` would not compile, contradicting the claimed green suite.
recommended_fix: Replace with `for _ in 0..<rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_NOC` to discard the index explicitly.

title: Env-armed e2e backdoor (input injection, screenshots, self-exit) now ships in release builds
detail: Dropping the PP_DEBUG gate arms a scripted-input/screenshot/forced-exit drive via a trivially settable env var in every shipped binary. The PR documents the CWE-489 trade-off, but the risk still ships.
recommended_fix: Keep the e2e drive behind a compile define (PP_DEBUG or a dedicated PP_NOC_E2E define); runtime-gate only the panel itself.

title: README says the runtime flag is 'OFF by default' — the flag defaults ON; the panel is what is OFF
evidence:
+panel (v2-noc; ships in every build behind a runtime flag — OFF by default
+so normal frames carry zero extra pixels; the "NOC PANEL (D)" row in the
... +    app.noc_enabled = true // the D key is available (the settings row "NOC PANEL (D)")
detail: 'behind a runtime flag — OFF by default' misdescribes the removal-path contract: noc_enabled boots true (default available); only overlay_on/panel pixels default OFF. Sloppy wording for the feature's headline behavior.
recommended_fix: Reword: 'the availability flag is ON by default; the panel itself is OFF until D, so normal frames carry zero extra pixels'.

title: value_chip_color: NOC row highlights its normal state, inverting the panel's abnormal-state convention
detail: Existing rows color only abnormal states (muted -> critical) and fall through to p.ink when normal; the NOC row instead colors the normal state (ON -> healthy green) and leaves OFF unhighlighted. Inconsistent chip polarity within one proc.
recommended_fix: Return p.ink for ON and highlight OFF (or nothing), matching the AUDIO row's convention of coloring only the abnormal state.
